failure.precondition: isolated non-production target; baseline /health=200 and /ready=200; DB assertions captured
failure.injection: temporarily apply approved low pool/connection timeout environment to one test app target
failure.expected: bounded 503 with Retry-After; /health remains 200; /ready reports unavailable without dependency details
failure.forbidden: raw 500, unbounded wait, committed partial write
failure.stop: stop immediately on raw 500, SLO breach, partial write, or unknown restore/cleanup evidence
failure.evidence: health/readiness samples, sanitized response summary, Hikari pending/timeout counters, DB before/after assertions
failure.restore: restore immutable environment and restart only the isolated test target
failure.cleanup: confirm original pool settings, /ready=200, no residual test rows or sessions

failure.precondition: isolated non-production target; Redis baseline and job/lock counts captured
failure.injection: apply approved unreachable Redis endpoint or bounded command timeout to one test target; never alter shared Redis
failure.expected: dependency-bound paths return bounded 503/Retry-After or documented DB/idempotency fallback
failure.forbidden: raw 500, duplicate job, lost idempotency, leaked Redis endpoint
failure.stop: stop immediately on raw 500, duplicate/orphan job, data loss, or unknown Redis restoration
failure.evidence: sanitized status/latency, retry metric, job and lock assertions, /health and /ready samples
failure.restore: restore immutable Redis configuration and restart isolated target
failure.cleanup: verify readiness, duplicate/orphan counts zero, residual injected configuration absent

failure.precondition: test traffic uses synthetic route and approved timeout override; provider call budget recorded
failure.injection: route isolated target to deterministic timeout stub or bounded client timeout
failure.expected: documented fallback or bounded 503 with Retry-After and provider failure reason
failure.forbidden: raw 500, request beyond SLO, live provider mutation, location trace in evidence
failure.stop: stop immediately on raw 500, SLO breach, live call, unsafe evidence, or unknown cleanup
failure.evidence: redacted request alias, status/latency, fallback marker, provider failure counter
failure.restore: restore immutable GraphHopper endpoint/timeout and restart isolated target
failure.cleanup: verify normal synthetic route, /ready=200, timeout stub has no residual allocation

failure.precondition: fake provider or approved failure stub; zero live-cost expectation; baseline fallback captured
failure.injection: select deterministic 429/timeout/error mode on fake AI or Kakao provider
failure.expected: feature-specific fallback/stale response, bounded retry, 429 or 503 according to API contract
failure.forbidden: raw 500, retry storm, token/credential URL, live billable call
failure.stop: stop immediately on raw 500, retry storm, live cost, secret exposure, or unknown cleanup
failure.evidence: fake-provider marker, sanitized status, retry count, fallback reason, cost counter zero
failure.restore: return fake provider to success mode and restore immutable endpoint
failure.cleanup: verify success probe, retry queue drained, no provider resource remains

failure.precondition: test job IDs and RUNNING lease snapshot captured; backlog and TTL budget approved
failure.injection: stop only the isolated worker process through approved service command
failure.expected: app remains live; jobs stay recoverable; bounded backlog; retry after worker restart
failure.forbidden: raw 500, duplicate/orphan job, job/data loss, lease without expiry
failure.stop: stop immediately on raw 500, duplicate/orphan job, data loss, expired recovery SLO, or unknown lease
failure.evidence: job state timeline, lease owner/expiry aliases, backlog metric, app health/readiness
failure.restore: restart the same immutable worker artifact
failure.cleanup: assert each test job converges once, RUNNING lease recovered, backlog returns to baseline

failure.precondition: isolated app target, immutable artifact SHA, target drain and rollback plan recorded
failure.injection: restart only the drained test app target
failure.expected: other target serves traffic; restarted target becomes ready before registration
failure.forbidden: raw 500, ALB unhealthy capacity, duplicate processing, data loss
failure.stop: stop immediately on raw 500, ALB unhealthy, duplicate/orphan work, data loss, or unknown target state
failure.evidence: target state timeline, /health and /ready, artifact checksum, request result summary
failure.restore: return original desired state and register only after readiness passes
failure.cleanup: all approved targets healthy, no drain residue, job/data assertions unchanged

recoveryDeployment.precondition: test jobs, lease TTL, app/worker artifact SHAs and baseline assertions captured
recoveryDeployment.injection: drain app then restart app/worker one at a time using approved service command
recoveryDeployment.expected: expired RUNNING lease is reclaimed once and each job converges exactly once
recoveryDeployment.forbidden: duplicate/orphan job, data loss, stale RUNNING lease, artifact mismatch
recoveryDeployment.stop: stop immediately on duplicate/orphan job, data loss, stale lease, artifact mismatch, or unknown cleanup
recoveryDeployment.evidence: restart timeline, lease transition, job counts, artifact checksums, health/readiness
recoveryDeployment.restore: restore original process counts and immutable artifacts
recoveryDeployment.cleanup: zero orphan/duplicate jobs, no stale lease, backlog baseline, all targets ready

recoveryDeployment.precondition: at least two healthy test targets; connection and SLO budget approved
recoveryDeployment.injection: deregister one explicitly named test target and wait for drain
recoveryDeployment.expected: in-flight requests finish within drain budget and remaining target stays healthy
recoveryDeployment.forbidden: ALB unhealthy, dropped write, raw 500, unknown target identity
recoveryDeployment.stop: stop immediately on ALB unhealthy/unknown, raw 500, dropped write, or unknown target/cleanup state
recoveryDeployment.evidence: target health transitions, in-flight result summary, ALB healthy count, cleanup receipt
recoveryDeployment.restore: register original target only after /health and /ready pass
recoveryDeployment.cleanup: target set equals baseline and every target is healthy

recoveryDeployment.precondition: current and previous jar paths are immutable, checksummed, and old artifact compatibility is proven
recoveryDeployment.injection: atomically switch current symlink to approved candidate; rollback switches to checksummed previous jar
recoveryDeployment.expected: candidate or previous artifact becomes ready within SLO without schema repair
recoveryDeployment.forbidden: checksum mismatch, rollback incompatibility, Flyway repair, raw 500, data loss
recoveryDeployment.stop: stop immediately on checksum/compatibility uncertainty, raw 500, data loss, failed readiness, or unknown cleanup
recoveryDeployment.evidence: before/after symlink target aliases, SHA-256, process status, health/readiness, DB assertions
recoveryDeployment.restore: switch to recorded known-good artifact and restart after explicit approval
recoveryDeployment.cleanup: one active process, known-good checksum active, temporary candidate removed by owner

recoveryDeployment.precondition: production-like disposable DB snapshot; migration and old/new jar SHAs recorded; backup receipt exists
recoveryDeployment.injection: print-only sequence: validate -> migrate expand-only schema -> new jar probe -> old jar compatibility probe
recoveryDeployment.expected: both artifacts operate against expanded schema; contract migration deferred until old artifact retirement
recoveryDeployment.forbidden: repair/reset, destructive contract before retirement, checksum mismatch, rollback incompatibility, data loss
recoveryDeployment.stop: stop immediately on repair/reset, checksum/compatibility uncertainty, data mismatch, or cleanup unknown
recoveryDeployment.evidence: Flyway info summary without URL, migration checksum, old/new probe results, row-count/hash assertions
recoveryDeployment.restore: discard disposable DB; production restoration requires separate approved backup/restore runbook
recoveryDeployment.cleanup: disposable resources removed with receipt; migration history and data assertions retained redacted
